planning_constraints: Pin the actually integrated F1-F3 revisions, final Task 003 preflight and Task 004 interruption/budget evidence before execution acceptance. Inspect delivered source/tests rather than infer success from completed lifecycle status. Recover missing integration via supported team lifecycle; never edit another checkout or create a parallel ledger.

Replace F4 TBD data structures/APIs and placeholder flow through Cascade read_doc/write_doc before feature sign-off. Specify scenario IDs, production entry points, fixture boundaries, independent effect counters, fault points, evidence schema, artifact bounds/redaction, exit status and prerequisite failures. Prepare complete Task acceptance/test plans at minting using the supported API; do not rely on later edits after automatic dispatch. Preserve exact refusal and owner if guards prevent a correction.

Smallest shippable sequence: extend the integrated positive journey and independent evidence collector; add adversarial/budget and five fault-mutation checks; wire mandatory CI with diagnostics and fresh-workspace instructions; execute the separately authorized supervisor exercise and reconcile final evidence/designs. Feature team chooses Task boundaries; do not duplicate prior integration harnesses or create a new scheduler, database or dashboard.

Retain .github/workflows/recovery-contract.yml and the named Recovery contract gate on relevant PRs and main; initial job timeout is 10 minutes and timeout fails. Include the actual owning-agent journey and existing review-recovery checks. Missing prerequisites must fail acceptance visibly, never skip, become manual-only, or continue-on-error. Declare CI runner/tool identities and setup separately from local manifest readiness. Retain bounded sanitized diagnostics on failure without prompts, credentials or private reasoning.

Use real temporary product/tracking repositories, bare remote, validators, worker processes, durable queues/checkpoints and production scoped tool adapters. Script only external paid-provider/forge transport. No fake repair/validation/publication/postcheck success, raw success setters, lifecycle rewrites or direct pushes to complete an admitted journey. Independently count provider/process/worker/Task/review/message/publication effects.

Cover real red checks, insufficient allowance, malformed policy, head/policy drift, stale admissions, remote competition, dirty changes, live owners, wrong scope, missing capability, denied authority/credentials and unavailable evidence. Inject crashes before claim, during checks, after commit, after push and before receipt. Exercise colocated/split roots and fresh process restart. Consume F3 Task 004 proof or extend it only where the final matrix demonstrates a gap.

Exercise one unchanged expensive failure, finite transient retries and paid-turn cap, competing reservations, provider-to-MCP-to-validator nesting under one claim, unknown usage, deadline/cancellation and attempted unreserved shell/process execution. Source, generation, restart, provider, cosmetic commit, policy-cycle, replacement-action and parent handoffs cannot renew original allowance. Repeated exhausted audit requests stay coalesced. Verify denied and authenticated independent finite extensions with prior consumption/history retained.

Measure the positive journey against approved defaults: 6 expensive attempts, 6 paid turns, 1800-second subprocess/model runtime pools, 300-second model turn, 3600-second elapsed deadline and known-token 200000 threshold. Preserve approved validator bounds and provider-specific enforcement limitations. Report usage as unavailable where unknown; no invented hard token/spend guarantee. Infeasibility needs independent policy/extension authority or an epic amendment, not relaxed checks or reset counters.

Independently break deduplication, validation, immutable publication, independent postcheck and receipt recovery in isolated reversible fault runs. Each relevant test must fail for its intended assertion; record mutation, tested revision, command and result. Restore pristine production checks and demonstrate the clean suite passes. An import error or unrelated crash alone does not prove the safeguard was tested.

Operational preflight must name exact environment and product/tracking/runtime roots, clean reviewed/integrated/installed/loaded identities, authorized actor/credentials, approved injection, supported UI/agent entry point, finite budget, rollback/cleanup and independent postcheck. A real supervisor exercise is separate from deterministic CI. No live deployment/install/restart is authorized by this handoff; absent authority is a named blocker while independent CI work proceeds.

Final dossier maps every epic criterion to exact source revision, commands/results, scenario/effect counts, original incident/profile/budget/actor/decision/claim IDs, crash/restart points, remote/deployment observations, retained diagnostics and remaining limitations. Keep reported versus independently verified evidence distinct. A valid loaded receipt cannot waive unfinished delivery or product acceptance. Passing F4 tests alone cannot recommend epic completion.

Reconcile every diagram row against the final integrated diff, including changes after F3 Task 003. Preserve stable requirement ownership, native Code metadata and actual declaration kinds; update designs/model/views/source contract together when needed. Record exact no-change reasons by level. Verify normal/failure/isolation/restart, stale symbols/moved ownership, UI navigation and pinned source, warm reuse and measured performance without per-view startup or weakened render bounds. No accepted snapshot rewrite.

Preserve Codex and explicit descendant role/model/reasoning settings. New parent policy, ownership or sequencing changes require the epic amendment protocol; ordinary F4 test/evidence work remains within approved scope.
